verdict.rationale: Stripe documents its own official Stripe CLI for building, testing, and managing a Stripe integration from the command line, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. That CLI serves the platform Billing runs on, but the evidence is a single descriptive line with no Billing-specific command detail. missing for 10: documented Billing-specific CLI commands (subscriptions, invoices, meters), AI/agent-oriented CLI workflow guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
